state_summary: Round 2, seed 157: 397 observed measured records, 2,933 current candidates, and no validation or test records. The previous 32 selections now have measured feedback. The objective remains Row-distribution V1/V2 accuracy; candidate predictions and V2−V1 widths are not measured errors or uncertainties.
important_observations: [observed measured; IDs 8136e1c1c9734ab0048d, d1e6e925623ba4b6810b, 6d00a25c0ca42a5cf2c1, 25dd969086d07da70d74, ddf2f769007f3d9f75fd] m167 shows a reproducible, molecule-specific ratio response dominated by V2. At 150 µl in DCM, V1/V2 increase from 4.392/12.433 at 2/1 to 4.983/20.142 at 20/1.

[observed measured; IDs facbcedbecb46072b04c, c8d43713db33bf820a1d, 4c32851430464f0ed684, 761c3f82d640da44966c, 549daca56bed1c9d2bcc] m125 remains a difficult local response surface. [observed measured; IDs 29db30571b2a1ae59cc7, b51b5dbcd2a38b174973, 96710afeabc594baa359] m90 is condition sensitive in the tail. At 5/1, the measured 50 and 150 µl records differ substantially in V1 while V2 remains high.

[observed measured; IDs b4e0e9dc92fca2c88b90, 36d971e3231c54486d05, 53a1acff30433cff819f, 17902fa9c7f8ea9b456e, 5a6c740e9306a2ffd60a] H3 is supported as a local-error hypothesis. m160 is severely underpredicted at 5/1 but close to prediction at 2/1; m161 has a different residual pattern. Positional or structural analogies are not interchangeable.

[observed measured; IDs e47aebe2660b9e1528de, 5097ef8f92148f920ca4, 33ffc69a253a89f15995, 504cddc93fa258cac929, 1e77ce24daad192212f6] m216 residuals change with condition, including strong underprediction at 10/1 and smaller or opposite behavior at other ratios. This weakens any universal aza-aromatic correction.

[observed measured; IDs 81507d463506a9e65e73, 3a095d378b537020c569] The endpoint-order anomaly remains rejected: both measured diagnostic compounds have V2 greater than V1, and their recorded predictions are ordered.

[general chemical knowledge and untested hypothesis] Silica hydrogen bonding and acid-base interactions from phenols, amines, oximes, nitro groups, and aza-aromatics may create local nonlinear behavior. The measured sign changes do not establish a universal residual direction.
candidate_scientific_questions: Does the m160 5/1 residual persist when injection volume is reduced, and does the matched m161 contrast behave differently?
Can an m216 injection-volume contrast distinguish a stable high-tail regime from a condition-specific model miss?
Does an intermediate m90 condition connect the measured 50 and 150 µl endpoints smoothly?
For m125, do lower-volume and loading-solvent-volume contrasts explain the large 2/1 tail shift while the 5/1 curve remains comparatively stable?
Does the weak-ratio end of the m167 curve continue its measured V2-dominant progression?
Does a lower-volume EA measurement for m92 extend the measured EA tail coherently?
Do additional basic aza-aromatics and donor-rich positional isomers reproduce the observed local errors or remain heterogeneous?
possible_model_blind_spots: The model may conflate PE/EA ratio, density, injection volume, loading amount, loading-solvent volume, and loading solvent. Matched contrasts are more interpretable than isolated extreme predictions.
Positional isomers and superficially similar aza-aromatics can have different silica interactions and residual signs, as shown by the m160/m161 and m216/m211 records.
V1 and V2 errors may be correlated in the high-volume tail, but the observed residuals do not support one common offset. Endpoint-specific or joint residual structure may be needed.
